notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ سَعِيدٌ الْأَعْرَجُ» names the asker; the one asked is only a pronoun, so the Imam is taken from prev1 (rule 5 and the Faqih ruling): prev1 (2841) writes «سَأَلَ أَبَانٌ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» and supplies the speaker
the Imam is the last link, after the asker; nothing in this text names him
